newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Buoyant dollar lifts Portuguese stocks.
newsitem.headline: Buoyant dollar lifts Portuguese stocks.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Shares closed firm, lifted by the buoyancy of the dollar which traditionally attracts foreign interest and the better tone to other European stock markets.
*Traders said that the market could continue positive on Wednesday provided that the dollar remained firm and Wall Street did not turn negative.
*"If the Dow Jones and dollar behave well, the market still has some room to gain," said one trader.
*Trade was heavily concentrated in a handful of the most liquid stocks -- Portugal Telecom, Banco Comercial, Cimpor and Portucel.
*The PS .PSI20 index closed 1.02 percent up at 6,752.95. Overall turnover was 9.1 billion escudos.
